Does a science keep itself steady?

Some things correct themselves. A thermostat does it in four steps.

It sensesThe room is cold.
It decidesColder than the setting.
It actsThe heat turns on.
It checks againWarm now. The heat turns off.

Scientists call this a regulation loop. We looked for one in every science.
